tasks.title: Normalize backend transcript assembly for opencode-style turns
tasks.spec: specs/http-api/spec.md#Requirement: Coder session detail exposes normalized transcript metadata
tasks.description: Make the session transcript service the canonical source for stable turn ordering, merged tool lifecycle records, normalized tool status, and richer patch/edit/write metadata. This task should eliminate duplicate started/completed tool parts in replay and ensure the API payload contains enough information for low-noise transcript rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: Replay transcript merges tool lifecycle events by toolCallId or equivalent inferred correlation so one logical tool produces one logical tool part
Unknown running placeholders with no meaningful input or output are suppressed from the primary payload when they cannot become user-visible tools
Patch, edit, and write tool parts expose file-level metadata including path, operation, and additions/deletions when recoverable
Transcript metadata includes stable counts and changed-file summaries needed by the session page
Backend transcript tests cover ordering, unknown-tool suppression, tool merge behavior, and patch metadata extraction
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the API shape additive where possible; prefer stronger normalization over schema redesign.

tasks.title: Add a display adapter for transcript-first session turns
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Session page reads as a Mohist-to-Coder transcript
tasks.description: Introduce a frontend display adapter that converts current session detail turns into prompt-led display turns with ordered assistant parts, grouped context tools, filtered internal noise, and turn-ending changed files. This task should give the UI a single render contract shared by replayed transcript data and later live updates.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter outputs prompt-led display turns with assistant parts for text, reasoning, tool, context-group, error, and divider states
Contiguous read/search/glob/list-style tools are grouped into a context-gathering part without losing failure visibility
todowrite is excluded from the default transcript projection and inferable tools do not fall back to unknown display rows unnecessarily
Patch/edit/write parts surface changed-file summaries into the display turn contract
Frontend tests cover prompt projection, context grouping, unknown filtering, and changed-file extraction from representative transcript fixtures
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the adapter pure so replay and live paths can share the same projection logic.

tasks.title: Rebuild the session page around centered transcript turns
tasks.spec: specs/session-timeline-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Session timeline uses opencode-like reading layout and live affordances
tasks.description: Replace the current dashboard-like transcript composition with a centered turn timeline that uses a sticky in-flow session title, user-message-like prompt blocks, ordered assistant parts, and readable empty/error states. This task should make the session page structurally resemble opencode before tool-specific polish is added.
acceptanceCriteria: The session page renders a centered transcript column with a sticky in-timeline header and a log-style turn list
Mohist prompts render as right-aligned low-saturation prompt blocks with collapsed raw prompt content and secondary actions for expand/copy
Assistant text and reasoning render as ordered parts instead of a separate coder label plus tool-card stack
Long transcript turns use a containment strategy such as content-visibility without breaking transcript reading
Frontend tests cover prompt rendering, sticky title presence, and transcript-first empty/error state behavior
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Focus this task on transcript layout and turn composition, not final tool/diff detail behavior.

tasks.title: Implement compact tool rows, context groups, and turn diffs
tasks.spec: specs/coder-session-tracking/spec.md#Requirement: Transcript assembly preserves stable tool identity and turn semantics
tasks.description: Replace heavy event-log tool cards with compact BasicTool-like rows, grouped context gathering, expandable tool details, and turn-ending diff sections for patch/edit/write activity. This task should make tool evidence feel like assistant content instead of a workflow log.
acceptanceCriteria: read, glob, grep/search, bash, apply_patch, edit/write, webfetch, and generic fallback tools render as compact transcript-native rows
Running and pending tools use subtle loading treatment and are not expanded by default, while completed and error tools expose expandable details
The primary transcript never shows Called unknown or duplicate running/completed rows for the same logical tool call
Patch/edit/write tools display file-aware summaries and each turn ends with a changed-files or diff section that supports expandable per-file details
Frontend tests cover compact tool rendering, grouped context rows, hidden todowrite noise, and per-file diff summaries
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Tool details may still expose raw input/output as fallback, but only behind expandable views.

tasks.title: Align live updates, thinking states, and auto-follow behavior
tasks.spec: specs/pipeline-session-events/spec.md#Requirement: Live session events converge with replayed transcript display
tasks.description: Refactor live session handling so SSE updates feed the same normalized display transcript used for replay, with subtle transcript status, thinking shimmer, paced live updates, and bottom-lock-aware scroll behavior. This task should make running sessions feel alive without relying on noisy tool-card churn.
acceptanceCriteria: Live tool start/update events update existing logical display parts instead of creating duplicate or orphan tool rows
Running sessions show subtle live status, inline spinner or progress treatment, and a thinking placeholder when no visible assistant content exists yet
Auto-follow pauses when the user scrolls away or selects text, ignores nested data-scrollable regions, and restores bottom lock correctly on resize when appropriate
Jump-to-bottom appears only when the user is meaningfully away from the bottom and new transcript content is available
Frontend tests cover live update convergence, thinking state behavior, and scroll follow or new-content interaction
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use a transcript-specific scroll state machine rather than a single near-bottom boolean.

tasks.title: Add regression fixtures and final transcript verification
tasks.spec: specs/agent-session-ui/spec.md#Requirement: Session page reads as a Mohist-to-Coder transcript
tasks.description: Add representative backend, API, and UI regression fixtures that model real coder sessions across prompt-heavy turns, grouped context gathering, patch tools, replay ordering, and live/refetch convergence. This task proves the completed transcript experience matches the change goals end to end and stays stable across refreshes.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression fixtures cover a large Mohist prompt, multi-turn transcript flow, grouped context tools, inferable patch tools, nested or missing tool-call ids, and interrupted or recovery states
Regression tests prove replay ordering is stable, inferable tools do not surface as unknown rows, and changed-file summaries remain attached to the correct turn
Regression tests prove live append followed by transcript refetch preserves equivalent visible grouping and ordering
Regression tests prove error, recovery, and auto-follow or jump-to-bottom behavior continue to work with the final transcript components
Tests pass
Build passes
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use regression fixtures to prove the proposal and all capability specs stay aligned across backend, API, live updates, and transcript UI.
